page0.text:
...Zouken Matou stands there, looking just as he did the night before.
He looks completely intact, even after Archer cut him in two.
The old mage, waiting only for death to claim him, laughs, as if the other night's events were all a dream.

page1.text:
His methods are a mystery, but if he's truly recovered, then they must be in the realm of restoration, not just healing.
You can't accomplish this by just healing a wound.
It's grand magecraft which returns a lost body from nothing to its original form.
So...does that mean he's immortal?

page2.text:
"What do you expect to accomplish by swinging a stick, boy?"
...
I face down Zouken with a Strengthened kyousaku stick.

page3.text:
I can't get any closer to him, nor can I run away to join Saber.
...If Zouken is immortal, then there's nothing I can do against him with a stick.

page4.text:
"Will you attack me, or go after your Servant? Either way, nothing will happen until you move your feet."
Insects squirm and chitter all around the old mage.
No, not just around him.
I can see the shadows moving, blocking out the moonlight.

page5.text:
"Bugs."
I know what they are, even if I can't see them.
The darkness is a disgusting horde of insects.
Darker than black, they fill all four corners of the shrine room, covering every wall.
The room is completely overrun by the bugs teeming over the walls, and the stench of rotten meat.

page6.text: "Why do you hesitate? You were the ones who disemboweled me the other day. Didn't you join forces with the Tohsaka girl to defeat me?"

page7.text:
...The insect-wielding Zouken is clearly enjoying this.
Obviously, I can't do a damn thing about the swarms of insects with a stick.
Zouken only needs to give the order to drown me in a sea of bugs.

page8.text:
No, maybe...
If I run outside as fast as I can, I might be able to break out of this desperate situation.
There's a lot of them, but they're just bugs.
I doubt they can take out a whole human in a matter of seconds.

page9.text:
"Whatever you do, I can wait.
Will you believe in Saber and wait for her return? Kill me with that weapon? Or break past my worms and run outside! The choice is yours."
